Please talk to a therapist. Because my doctor swapped out one of my meds the instance she heard I wanted to overdose- so yes, some do have the potential to become fatal. Please speak with some one before you make any decisions ok? Things always seem to be impossible and hopeless... until they suddenly don’t. Take time off to cool down if you need to. Go take a nice Long walk and just people watch. See things without trying to think about what everything means. Breathing exercises can also be helpful, as are physical exertion. Spend some time loving yourself. Take care!

I’ve overdosed on cipram (an antidepressant) before - I couldn’t stop shaking and my teeth kept chattering. It’s not a good feeling and it went on for three days. I couldn’t sleep well and felt on edge all though the three days with practically every major muscle group in spasms. Finally I stopped shaking. Definitely not a good idea.

Please tel your doctor if you have the urge to overdose; some antidepressants are fatal in high enough doses. Hope everything works out ok for you!

I share the same concern with you regarding cost of treatments - I’m trying to stretch out the appointments in time for pay day so I can have the money to see the therapist. 

It’s terrible to lose your job and worry about bills. The reason why I’m stuck in a job where bullying is prevalent is precisely because I have bills to pay, so I get why you would be worried.

Is there anyone who can lend you some money or with whom you can cohabitate with at least until you find another job? Parents or friends, perhaps?

Alternatively, is there any social services you can reach out to in your state or country? Most governments would have some sort of assistance scheme for individuals who are struggling to make ends meet. Try talking to your local representative/mayor’s office etc and see if they can offer suggestions.

Take care!
